summary: V5.4 Living Ecosystem tested. Backend: 7/7 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_v54.py PASS — POST /admin/seed-demo (GM/admin gated, deploys Evereantha+Artisan), GET /campaigns/{cid}/ecosystem/pulse (returns Malshe Darkening evolving motive at epic-7-milestones + 'Pass-of-Aurea Ambush' encounter), POST /nodes/{nid}/motive round-trip, gm_only visibility hidden from non-GM, /ecosystem/pulse 403 for player. Frontend: Account 'Deploy demo campaigns' button (data-testid='account-demo-deploy-btn') visible + clicking POSTs /admin/seed-demo (status 200 confirmed via network listener). CampaignGenesis renders '0/9 PHASES' progress and the 9th tab 'Reference Library' opens the ReferenceEditor + Quickstart Instructions panel cleanly. CRITICAL BUG: Director Console crashes with 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' on the seeded Evereantha campaign because GET /api/campaigns/{cid} returns HTTP 500 — root cause is demo_seed.py not setting `visibility` on the campaign doc, and routes/campaigns.py:257 reading camp['visibility'] via subscript instead of .get().

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 'KeyError: visibility' for any campaign created by /admin/seed-demo. demo_seed.py base_camp dict omits the 'visibility' key, but routes/campaigns.py line 257 uses camp["visibility"] (subscript). All Director Console / campaign-detail UI surfaces break on the new demo campaigns because of this. Reproduction: POST /admin/seed-demo as GM → GET /api/campaigns/{returned_id} → 500.

ui_bugs.issue: Renders 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' for newly-seeded demo campaigns because the campaign GET 500s upstream (see backend critical bug). director-pulse-panel + V5.3 testids never mount. Director endpoint itself returns 200; only the wrapping campaign fetch crashes.

integration_issues.issue: Account → Deploy demo button POSTs /admin/seed-demo and returns 200, but the deployed campaigns are unreachable in the UI because of the visibility KeyError. The deploy button itself works correctly.

action_items: Fix demo_seed.py: add `"visibility": "private"` (or "public") to the base_camp dict around line 224 so seeded campaigns are well-formed.
OR (defence-in-depth) change routes/campaigns.py line 257 from camp["visibility"] to camp.get("visibility", "private") so legacy/seeded docs without the field don't 500.
After the fix, re-verify the Director Console PulsePanel renders motives≥1 + encounters≥1 on the latest seeded Evereantha campaign.
critical_code_review_comments: demo_seed.py is missing a `visibility` key on base_camp — this is the kind of field that any centralised campaign factory should fill. Recommend a single `_make_campaign_doc(...)` helper in core/db (or a Pydantic CampaignDoc with defaults) so seed/clone/create paths cannot diverge again.

routes/campaigns.py uses both `camp["visibility"]` (subscript) and `camp.get("member_ids", [])` in the same expression — inconsistent defensiveness. Standardise on .get() for any field that could legitimately be absent in older docs.

ecosystem.py is clean: gm-only is enforced, motive entries are append-only, gm_only filter is applied on the read side, Pulse aggregation correctly limits journal to 25 entries and motives to latest-per-node. No bugs found in the V5.4 surface itself.

DirectorConsole.jsx PulsePanel + PulseCol code is fine — it only fails to render because the parent page errors out. Once the 500 is fixed, the panel will mount with the four columns wired to /ecosystem/pulse?plot_phase=…
CampaignGenesis.jsx PHASES array correctly carries 9 entries; progressPct uses PHASES.length so it reads 0/9. phase===8 branch renders ReferenceEditor + InstructionsPanel cleanly — verified live.

success_rate.frontend: 66% — Account deploy button OK, Genesis 0/9 + Phase 9 OK, Director Console BROKEN on seeded campaigns (campaign GET 500)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the demo_seed.py visibility bug, retest by: (1) running pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_v54.py (must still pass), (2) curl GET /api/campaigns/{any_seeded_cid} should return 200, (3) browse /app/campaigns/{cid}/director and assert director-pulse-panel + four PulseCol testids visible with motives count≥1 + encounters count≥1. The Genesis 0/9 fix and Account deploy button are already verified working. /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_v53.py V5.3 regression suite is unchanged and still authoritative.
rca of the issue: demo_seed.py:_seed_one() builds the campaign document at lines 203-228 without a `visibility` field. routes/campaigns.py:257 reads `camp["visibility"]` via subscript when checking membership/visibility on GET /api/campaigns/{cid}. Result: every demo-seeded campaign 500s on detail fetch, which cascades into the Director Console error boundary. Mitigation A (preferred): add `"visibility": "private"` to the base_camp dict. Mitigation B (defence-in-depth): change subscript to `.get("visibility", "private")` in campaigns.py. Both are one-line fixes.
